newsitem.title: USA: Sawtek files for 2.5 mln common share.
newsitem.headline: Sawtek files for 2.5 mln common share.

text.p: Sawtek Inc said Tuesday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of up to 2.5 million common shares.
Of the total, Sawtek said it would sell 300,000 shares and shareholders would offer 2.2 million shares.

The shares to be sold by shareholders include 2.0 million shares that will be offered by the company's Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). The ESOP shares to be sold represent about 20 percent of the plan's holdings.
Sawtek said it expects the offering to take place by July 1.
